title: Benchmarking memory and nonlinear processing capacity of quantum recurrent neural networks for time series prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.21552v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum machine learning has emerged as a promising approach to time series prediction. While quantum reservoir computing has been widely explored for this setting, variational quantum models tailored to sequential data remain comparatively understudied, largely because they are difficult to train. In this work, we present a rigorous benchmark of variational quantum recurrent neural networks (QRNNs) on time series prediction tasks, focusing on two key capabilities: memory and nonlinear processing. We introduce a task-driven methodology that quantifies model capacity, enabling an intuitive and fair comparison across architectures, including classical recurrent baselines. We evaluate the proposed framework on two generic benchmark tasks and on a synthetic dataset describing a chaotic system. Overall, the quantum models achieve performance comparable to their classical counterparts, but classical models scale better with the memory size w

translated_title: 用于时间序列预测的量子循环神经网络的记忆与非线性处理能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习已成为时间序列预测的一种有前景的方法。虽然量子储层计算在该场景下已被广泛探索，但针对序列数据量身定制的变分量子模型仍相对缺乏研究，主要原因在于其难以训练。在本工作中，我们对变分量子循环神经网络（QRNN）在时间序列预测任务上进行了严格的基准测试，聚焦于两个关键能力：记忆和非线性处理。我们提出了一种任务驱动的方法来量化模型容量，实现了包括经典循环神经网络基线在内的各种架构之间直观而公平的比较。我们在两个通用基准任务和一个描述混沌系统的合成数据集上评估了所提出的框架。总体而言，量子模型取得了与经典模型相当的性能，但经典模型在记忆规模上的扩展性更好。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种任务驱动的模型容量量化方法，对变分量子循环神经网络在时间序列预测中的记忆与非线性处理能力进行了严格基准测试，发现量子模型性能与经典模型相当，但经典模型在记忆规模扩展上更具优势。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a task-driven methodology to benchmark the memory and nonlinear processing capacity of variational quantum recurrent neural networks on time series prediction, finding that quantum models achieve performance comparable to classical counterparts, though classical models scale better with memory size.
